entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, and you've reached VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these absolutely awful cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!

I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

It's under David Miller, D-A-V-I-D Miller. Just find the order. These things gave me massive blisters after one ride! The cleats are impossible to adjust correctly. I want a refund, and I want it now. This is ridiculous.
Okay, Mr. Miller, thank you. I'm pulling up your account now. I see the order for the Pro-Gear cycling shoes, delivered 43 days ago. Is that correct?

43 days, a month, whatever! Does it matter? They're defective! I want my money back. If you try to give me some runaround, I'm going straight to your manager and I'll be posting reviews about these terrible shoes and your service on every cycling forum online.

I understand your frustration with the fit and the blisters, sir, and I can assure you there will be no runaround. I'm just checking our return policy for you... Okay, I have good news. For standard items like these shoes, you are well within our 90-day return window.
So you're actually going to give me a refund? A full one?

Yes, absolutely. I'm authorizing a full refund for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email we have on file. All you need to do is package the shoes and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Well, okay then. That's... what I wanted. So I just print the label and send them back?
That's correct. The email with the label and instructions should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Miller?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
